Aufgaben
Till here, Operations Lead at handly. I thought about giving you the standard HR description of a job.
I won’t. handly is the most personally and intellectually rewarding environment I have seen so far. You will do exactly what I am doing right now. So chances are, you will dig it a lot, too!

s.h: Here is what makes it so great
s.t:
We grow roofing companies by taking away their administrative work and giving them the tools to sell that only big companies would have. Seeing and enabling the growth of talented roofing masters through handly is the most rewarding thing you can imagine.
We earn money through a revenue share of our partner businesses. This aligns our incentives 100% - meaning incredible transparency and trust between us and the craftsmen.
Our craftsmen deliver real value to customers - the young family who wants to renovate their newly bought home. There is incredibly more demand than supply. Our customers’ customers are incredibly thankful, for the service that our partner companies can deliver to them through handly.
You are the owner of this relationship. Together with the owner of the craftsmen company, you will launch the company and grow it to €1M revenue and beyond. You will do that with 10 companies eventually.
Through our revenue share business model, you sit exactly at the most important point of our operation. Your daily work generates handly’s revenue. This makes the role of Venture Development Manager the most critical role of the company. A good point to grow from.
Be responsible for the development of 10 recently founded roofing companies

Assist and coach the companies in lead generation, sales, operations, and finance
Strengthen handly’s value proposition: helping roofing businesses grow faster and more profitably
Joining Handly as Venture Development Manager means working directly with the Leadership Team from day one. This gives you two major advantages:
Autonomy : You’ll have the freedom to act quickly, with direct support from decision-makers who trust you to get things done.
Growth Opportunities : As Handly grows, so will your responsibilities. This role sets you up to lead key areas in the future or even gain support for your own entrepreneurial ventures.
Qualifikation
Berlin-based or willing to relocate (we can help on that)

This is not just the next step; it’s the start of long-term impact and personal growth.
We are supported by leading venture capitalists, including Harry Stebbings (20VC), Fred Destin (Stride), base10, and Julian Teicke (Founder of wefox and The Delta). Our advisors include Ershad Jamil, former CGO at ServiceTitan, who helped grow the company into the world’s largest craftsmen startup, now publicly listed with a $10 billion market cap.

This role involves close collaboration with Brand Managers and Sourcing Agents to ensure the products meet the evolving needs of the customers and maintain competitive advantage. About the company: It is a fast-growing brand developing several new green and sustainable products for eco-conscious consumers .

Currently, the company sells mostly on Amazon, but it also operates on Shopify and Walmart. It has over 200,000 customers in 7 countries (USA, Canada, Mexico, UK, Germany, Japan, China). Wir sind Una, ein missiongetriebenes Unternehmen, welches die ständig wachsende Herausforderung durch Stoffwechselkrankheiten in Angriff nimmt.
Durch die Kombination von neuester medizinischer Forschung, KI, Biosensortechnologie und nutzer:innenzentriertem Design entwickeln wir die erste digitale Therapie, die Stoffwechselstörungen nachhaltig löst .
Wir werden von exzellenten Investoren wie Food Labs, PeakBridge, Plug and Play und DART Labs sowie von Angels wie den Gründern von mySugr/9amHealth und Ada Health unterstützt.
Nachdem wir uns zu der am häufigsten verschriebenen DiGA für Diabetes entwickelt haben, ist es ein sehr spannender Zeitpunkt, Teil unseres schnell wachsenden und ehrgeizigen Teams zu werden und die Zukunft des Unternehmens maßgeblich mitzugestalten.
Wir suchen derzeit ein erfahrenes Teammitglied (w/m/d) zur sofortigen Verstärkung unseres Teams in Vollzeit. Du bist federführend bei der Durchführung klinischer Studien sowie der Zusammenarbeit mit renommierten akademischen Institutionen und unterstützt uns dabei, unsere Lösungen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Aufgaben
Unterstütze uns dabei, die Wirksamkeit unserer innovativen digitalen Therapie zu validieren, sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und unsere Evidenzbasis wissenschaftlich aufzubereiten – mit dem Ziel, die Versorgung und Prävention bei metabolischen Erkrankungen nachhaltig zu verbessern.
Leite und koordiniere klinische Studien (RCTs, RWE) zur Untersuchung unserer digitalen Therapien für metabolische Krankheiten.
Arbeite eng mit unseren akademischen Partner, Studienzentren und externen Dienstleistern (z. B. CROs) zusammen bei der Durchführung von Studien
Kollaboriere intern mit interdisziplinären Teams, um innovative digitale Gesundheitslösungen zu entwickeln.
Analysiere und interpretiere wissenschaftliche Daten zur Unterstützung von Zulassungen, Produktentwicklung und Kommunikation an die Ärzteschaft.
Unterstütze bei der Erstellung wissenschaftlicher Publikationen und Präsentationen.
Überwache regulatorische Anforderungen und stelle sicher, dass alle Projekte den gesetzlichen Vorgaben entsprechen.
Qualifikation
Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Wir suchen keine perfekte Checkliste, sondern Menschen mit Motivation und Potenzial.
Qualifikationen : Abgeschlossenes Studium der Medizin, Biologie, Gesundheitswissenschaften, Pharmazie (oder eines vergleichbaren Fachs) bzw. eine spezifische Qualifikation in der klinischen Forschung.
Erfahrung und Kenntnisse : Mindestens 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Planung und Durchführung klinischer Studien (RCTs, RWE) im Pharma-, Medtech- oder DiGA-Umfeld. Nachweisbare Stärke in der Auswahl, Steuerung und Budget-/Timeline-Verhandlung von CROs und Prüfzentren. Zudem solide Kenntnisse im Regulierungsumfeld (MDR, DiGAV) und GCP.

Leidenschaft : Du bist motiviert von unserer Mission und dem Potenzial der digitalen Gesundheit für unsere Gesellschaft und begeistert von der Aussicht, die Rolle neuartiger Technologien im Bereich Diabetes und Stoffwechselkrankheiten zu erforschen
Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest gut organisiert, proaktiv und eigenverantwortlich. Herausforderungen gehst du pragmatisch an, um Themen schnell umzusetzen und direkten Impact zu erzielen

Autodesk 's Technical Advisory organization is building a digital consulting platform powered by implementation expertise captured from hundreds of enterprise engagements. That expertise needs to become customer-facing content — structured, validated, and published through the platform and through sales and positioning materials. The Principal Solution Development Manager will orchestrate that production.
Reporting to the Senior Manager, Content & Knowledge within Global Delivery & Solutions, you will manage the end-to-end content production pipeline: taking requirements from product managers, subject matter experts, and platform colleagues, sourcing content from internal consultants and external vendors, managing production through to completion, and validating the result directly with customers.

You are not the primary content creator — you ensure the right content gets built by the right people, on time, to standard.
In the first year, you will establish the content production workflow, build the contributor network of internal SMEs and external vendors, publish customer-facing platform content and positioning materials, and run customer validation sessions that create a feedback loop between what we publish and what customers actually need.

Content Production Management
Intake content requirements from subject matter experts, product managers, and other platform colleagues and translate them into production plans with clear scope, timelines, and acceptance criteria
Source and manage content contributors across multiple channels: internal consultants and SMEs, external vendors, and contractors
Develop and maintain content briefs, production standards, and quality gates that enable consistent output regardless of who produces the content
Manage contributor relationships including scoping, contracting, and quality review
Track and report on pipeline throughput: what's in progress, what's blocked, what's delivered, what's next
Maintain momentum across concurrent production workstreams — identifying blockers early and escalating when needed
Customer Validation and Feedback
Plan and run customer validation sessions to test whether published content meets real customer needs and implementation scenarios
Design repeatable validation workflows and standards that can be executed by others — consultants, product managers, or delivery teams — so validation scales beyond any single person
Synthesize customer feedback into actionable inputs: what content needs improving, what's missing, what should be retired
Feed validation insights back to product management and the content production pipeline to drive continuous improvement
Cross-Functional Coordination
Work with the Content & Knowledge team to understand what knowledge is available, how it’s structured, and what’s ready for customer-facing production
Partner with solution product managers to stay aligned on content requirements and priorities
Coordinate with GTM on sales and positioning material needs, ensuring alignment between platform content and how offerings are presented to market
Contribute actively in team meetings — sharing progress, offering input on team decisions, and supporting colleagues

Experience engaging directly with enterprise customers for content or product validation

Ability to develop clear content standards and quality criteria for both internal and external contributors
Bachelor's degree in communications, business, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
